name: study-microbit-with-test
description: micro:bit 用方位磁石アプリケーション学習プロジェクト（ブロック・Python・TypeScript）

scripts.test:all: npm run test:python && npm run test:ts && npm run test:makecode
scripts.test:python: cd sample-compass && uv run pytest test/test_simulator.py -v
scripts.integration: npm run integration:python && npm run integration:ts
scripts.integration:python: cd sample-compass && uv run pytest test/test_simulator.py -v
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run build:ts
scripts.lint:python: cd sample-compass && uv run python -m py_compile src/compass_makecode.py
scripts.build:hex: cd sample-compass && uv run python -m uflash dist/hex/compass.hex && npm --prefix sample-compass-makecode run build
